title: Zone air distribution effectiveness.
officialText:
The zone air distribution effectiveness (E ) shall be determined using Table z 403.3.1.2.

ZONE AIR DISTRIBUTION EFFECTIVENESSa,b,c,d,e

ventilation achieves unidirectional flow and thermal stratification.

space temperature and provided that the 150 foot-per-minute supply air jet reaches to within 4½ feet of floor level.
